funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Open Scheme 09/26
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Society in good standing for at least 12 months. Non-members may also apply with the support of a Society member.
opportunities.summary: Support for activities not covered by another Society scheme, all of which should support the Society's mission. Recurring deadlines 1 March, 1 June, 1 September & 1 December.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Public Engagement Scheme 09/26

amount.raw: A maximum sum of £3,000 per application

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Society in good standing for at least 12 months. Non-members may also apply with the support of a Society member.
opportunities.summary: Support for activities related to the promotion of public awareness and understanding of pathology. Recurring deadlines 1 March, 1 June, 1 September & 1 December.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Consultant's Pump Priming Small Grant 10/26

amount.raw: A maximum sum of £15,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Society in good standing for 12 months. For consultants (or Honorary Consultants) in Histopathology or senior scientific non-clinical researcher (at least Senior Lecturer level).
opportunities.summary: To encourage consultants (or Honorary Consultants) in Histopathology or senior scientific non-clinical researchers to undertake investigative research in histopathology. Recurring deadlines 1 April and 1 October.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Equipment Grant Scheme 10/26

amount.raw: A maximum sum of £15,000 per application

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Society based in Great Britain & Ireland in good standing for at least 12 months. Non-members may apply as co-applicants with a member of the Society.
opportunities.summary: Support for part purchase of items of equipment and/or software for pathologists actively engaged in research. Recurring deadlines 1 April & 1 October.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Hodgkin Early Career Pathology Researcher Grant 10/26

amount.raw: Up to £1000 (Hodgkin early career grant)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Society based in Great Britain or Ireland in a Foundation year 1 or 2 post or a Trainee 1-3 post in Histopathology.
opportunities.summary: To encourage early career pathology researchers, in particular trainees in the first few years of their careers, to undertake investigative research. Recurring deadlines 1 April & 1 October.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: JSPS Clinical Lecturer Grant 10/26

amount.raw: Up to £220,000 over a maximum of 4 years (50% salary, up to £20K consumables per year)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Trainee members of the Society, based in Great Britain or Ireland, in a recognised Specialist Trainee in Histopathology or Dental/Oral Pathology (post FRCPath part 1 or within 6 months of taking the exam). Applicants should have been members for at least 12 months.
opportunities.summary: To offer histopathology trainees post PhD/MD the chance to continue research part-time whilst completing clinical training. Recurring deadlines 01 April and 01 October.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Trainee Small Grant Scheme 10/26

amount.raw: A maximum sum of £15,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Trainees (specialist registrars or honorary specialist registrars), consultants & post-doctoral histopathology trainees who are members of the Society.
opportunities.summary: To encourage investigative research in histopathology, particularly aimed at generating research data which may contribute towards a substantive application to a funding body. Recurring deadlines 1 April and 1 October.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: JSPS Clinical Lecturer Support Grant 10/26

amount.raw: £60,000 per annum funding over a 2 year period

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Trainee members of the Society for at least 2 years who have completed a PhD or MD usually within the preceding 5 years and be in a recognised Specialist trainee (normally ST3 and above) histopathology programme accredited for CCT in histopathology in Great Britain & Ireland.
opportunities.summary: To offer support for continuing research projects over a 2 year period by academic trainee histopathologists following the award of a PhD or MD, when progressing through the final stages of histopathological training leading up to CCT. Recurring deadlines 01 April and 1 October.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: JSPS Clinical PhD Fellowship 10/26

amount.raw: 3 years of PhD funding covering trainee's salary, university fees and consumables budget of £20,000 per year for 3 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Trainee members of the Society, based in Great Britain or Ireland, in a recognised Specialist Trainee 1-6 post in Histopathology or other tissue specialty within pathology.
opportunities.summary: To provide 3 years of PhD funding for medically qualified trainees in Histopathology or other tissue specialities within Pathology, to increase research skills in tissue-based research projects. Recurring deadlines 01 April & 01 October.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: JSPS Intermediate Research Fellowship 10/26

amount.raw: Up to £120,000 over a maximum of 2 years (50% salary, up to £20K consumables per year)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must have a PhD/MD and have completed clinical training at the time of taking up the award in either Histopathology or Dental/Oral Pathology. Applicants should have been a member of the Society for at least 12 months.
opportunities.summary: To support newly accredited pathologists during the period between completing their training and obtaining full funding for a Clinician Scientist post through MRC, Wellcome, CRUK etc. Recurring deadlines 01 April & 01 October.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: JSPS Pre-Doctoral Research Bursary 10/26

amount.raw: Up to a maximum of £50,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Trainee members of the Society, based in Great Britain or Ireland, in a recognised Specialist Trainee 1-5 post in Histopathology.
opportunities.summary: To promote research in pathology by funding short projects for early career clinical academic research trainee pathologists for periods of 3, 6, 9, 12 months. Recurring deadlines 01 April & 01 October.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Leishman Early Career Pathology Researcher Grant 10/26

amount.raw: Up to £2000 (Leishman early career grant)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Society based in Great Britain or Ireland in a Foundation year 1 or 2 post or a Trainee 1-3 post in Histopathology.
opportunities.summary: To encourage early career pathology researchers, in particular trainees in the first few years of their careers, to undertake investigative research. Recurring deadlines 01 April and 1 October.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: PhD Studentship (Non-Clinical) 10/26

amount.raw: Support for a four year PhD including stipend, research & training allowance, conference allowance and consumables of up to £15,000 per annum, set at MRC rates

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Society based in Great Britain and/or Ireland in good standing for at least 12 months who wish to act as supervisors of a project leading to a PhD. Priority given to early career researchers in pathology.
opportunities.summary: Support for a four year PhD. Deadline 1 October.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Post-Doctoral Collaborative Small Grant 10/26

amount.raw: A maximum sum of £15,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: The academic histopathologist applicant must be a member of the Pathological Society in good standing for at least 12 months. The post-doctoral scientist applicant must be a member, have a PhD and be employed at scientific grade 6-9.
opportunities.summary: To cement a new or developing collaborative partnership between medical trainees and science-based trainees. Recurring deadlines 1 April and 1 October.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Visiting Fellowship 10/26

amount.raw: A maximum sum of £5,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Medical and allied professions working in pathologically-related bio-medical research. Applications accepted from non-members and members of the Society based in Great Britain & Ireland.
opportunities.summary: Support to enable travel to other institutions to learn new techniques of value in research, with preference for molecular & cell biology techniques. Recurring deadlines 1 April and 1 October.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: International Collaborative Grant Scheme 10/26

amount.raw: A maximum sum of £15,000 per application

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Society from Great Britain and/or Ireland in good standing for at least 12 months.
opportunities.summary: To develop and/or strengthen collaboration in scholarly pathological activities between pathology institutions in Great Britain & Ireland and international institutions. Recurring deadlines 01 April, 01 October.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Education Grant Scheme 10/26

amount.raw: The sum requested should not exceed £5,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Society who have been in membership for a minimum of 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support a range of activities in the performance, development and assessment of undergraduate & postgraduate education in pathology. Recurring deadlines 1 April & 1 October.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Intercalated Degree 11/26

amount.raw: University fees of up to £9,000, stipend £5,000 and consumables £1,800

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Medical, dental or veterinary undergraduates who are members of the Society based in UK &/or Ireland.
opportunities.summary: An annual sum to support intercalating degree students (either BSc or MRes/MSc). Deadlines 31 March & 1 November.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Cuthbert Dukes Grant Scheme 2027

amount.raw: A maximum sum of £20,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Trainee members of the Society for at least 12 months, based in Great Britain or Ireland, in a recognised specialist trainee 2-6 post in histopathology or dental/oral pathology.
opportunities.summary: To encourage early to mid career pathology researchers, in particular academic trainees in the early to mid stages of their career (specialist trainees 2-6) in histopathology, to undertake investigative tissue-based research. Deadline 1 April.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Student Society Bursary Scheme

amount.raw: The sum requested should not exceed £500

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established student societies where the applicant is a member of the Society based in UK &/or Ireland.
opportunities.summary: Support for the promotion of the understanding of pathology amongst medical, dental and biomedical students. No deadline - ongoing.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: JSPS Summer Studentships 2026

amount.raw: Up to £250 per week, with a maximum of £1,250 per student (equivalent to a 5 week placement)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-active, medically qualified, Consultant Pathologists or Clinical Lecturers (or local equivalent), who are members of the Pathological Society and in a substantive or honorary post at a University or Research Institute.
opportunities.summary: A joint bursary with the Jean Shanks Foundation to support Year 1 and Year 2 medical and dental students to carry out a research project in pathology during vacation periods. Applications reviewed on a rolling basis from 1 January - 31 October.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Winter Pathological Society Travel Bursary for Concessionary (with RSM) 2027

amount.raw: Up to £500, with an additional amount of up to £125 available for child care fees

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Post-graduate students (PhD, MD or MSc) or Pathology Trainees who are members of the Society. Members who have been awarded a PathSoc travel bursary within the last 6 months are ineligible.
opportunities.summary: To cover costs to attend a Winter Path Society meeting, contributing towards travel, accommodation and registration fees. Deadline 20 December for the Winter Meeting in January of the following year.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Winter Pathological Society Travel Bursary for Undergraduates/FD (with RSM) 2027

amount.raw: Up to £350

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate and Foundation Doctor members of the Society. Members who have been awarded a PathSoc travel bursary within the last 6 months are ineligible.
opportunities.summary: To cover costs of up to £350 to attend a Winter Pathological Society meeting, contributing towards travel, accommodation and registration fees. Deadline 20 December for the Winter Meeting in January of the following year.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Travel & Conference Bursary (external events)

amount.raw: The Travel & Conference bursary is up to £500.00 and must supplement monies from other sources

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Concessionary members of the Society in good standing for 12 months and Undergraduate/Foundation Doctor members of the Society. Members awarded a PathSoc travel bursary within the last 6 months are ineligible.
opportunities.summary: To cover the costs of travel and/or registration fees to promote scientific communications at major international meetings. For external events only. No deadline - ongoing.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: 2026 Undergraduate Essay Competition

amount.raw: Prize: £500

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate members of the Society.
opportunities.summary: Essay competition on the title 'How can personalised pathology facilitate personalised medicine?'. The winning essay is published on the website and the award presented at the Path Soc Winter Meeting the following year.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: CRUK / Path Soc Predoctoral Research Bursary

deadlines.raw: March and September of each year

amount.raw: Funding support for up to £50,000 to cover salary and/or research expenses over a period of up to 12 months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Clinicians early in their careers, considered from any area of CRUK's funding remit with the exception of clinical trials and drug development.
opportunities.summary: Joint Predoctoral Research Bursaries providing short term funding to allow clinicians to get involved in cancer research projects early in their careers. Deadlines March and September of each year.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Publication Grant Scheme (Journal of Pathology: Clinical Research)

amount.raw: Society pays the article processing charge for accepted papers

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Corresponding Authors who are Society Members in good standing (for a minimum of 12 months) whose papers have been accepted for publication in the Journal of Pathology: Clinical Research.
opportunities.summary: Open grant scheme to pay the article processing charge for Society members' papers accepted for publication in the Journal of Pathology: Clinical Research. Ongoing, no stated deadline.
